The '''Hunnoverrs sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It contained the [[Nishr system/Legends|Nishr system]].

==History==
The Hunnoverrs sector was terrorized by [[Danaan Kerr]] in the wake of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' place the [[Tellanroaeg system/Legends|Tellanroaeg system]] on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] within grid square S-17.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> That territory corresponds to a section of the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]], according to [https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors]. However, the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] instead places the Tellanroaeg system in the Hunnoverrs sector, which this article assumes to be erroneous.<ref name="Tellanroaeg">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' place the [[Tellanroaeg system/Legends|Tellanroaeg system]] on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] hyperroute within grid square S-17, which corresponds to a section of the Gaulus sector, according to {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}.</ref>
